in_sanskrit.name: संकल्प
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The word Sankalp is derived from two Sanskrit roots - Sam (सं) meaning ‘together’ and Kalp (कल्प) meaning ‘to plan’. Thus, the name Sankalp signifies the act of planning together, making a resolution or taking a pledge. It is a powerful name that embodies determination, focus, and commitment.

in_hindi.name: संकल्प
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Sankalp is identical to its Sanskrit counterpart. It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit - ‘Resolution, determination, vow, pledge’. The name is often used to inspire strength, resolve, and commitment in individuals.

in_tamil.name: சங்கல்பம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Sankalpam is derived from the Sanskrit word Sankalp. It is composed of two Tamil roots - Sam (சம்) meaning ‘together’ and Kalpam (கல்பம்) meaning ‘to plan’. The name Sankalpam signifies the act of planning together, making a resolution or taking a pledge. It is a name that embodies determination, focus, and commitment.

in_telugu.name: సంఖ్యప్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Sankhya is derived from the Sanskrit word Sankalp. It is composed of two Telugu roots - Sam (సమ) meaning ‘together’ and Khyam (ఖ్యమ) meaning ‘to plan’. The name Sankhya signifies the act of planning together, making a resolution or taking a pledge. It is a name that embodies determination, focus, and commitment.

in_marathi.name: Sankalp
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sankalp हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A firm resolve or decision, a solemn promise, a resolve to do something, a wish or a desire, a determination to achieve something
